sources.title: Government of The Gambia: Immigration and Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live gambia.gov.gm entry page is the central Government's immigration-and-visa guidance. It names broad exempt categories and a mission-availability-dependent airport-issuance statement, but no country-code schedule for the residual.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Where there is no Gambian diplomatic representative, participants shall have the privilege to obtain entry visa at the Banjul International Airport.

sources.title: Government of The Gambia: Gambia Immigration Department
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government's live agency directory identifies GID and its statutory immigration function, including visa issuance at foreign missions and upon arrival, without assigning either route by nationality or ordinary-passport type.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Issuance of visa at Gambia’s foreign missions abroad as well as upon arrival.
